answer: Locks are entered in ledge, expire in fable, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 7 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 98 aliases as a result needs 32 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4819 identities would post 4569 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
